source.name: Portland Timbers: Portland Timbers enter multi-year partnership with Bank of America to become front-of-jersey partner
source.quote: The Portland Timbers today announced Bank of America as the club’s new front-of-jersey partner in a multi-year deal
source.note: Date previously recorded as 2026-01-15; the identical announcement appeared in Bank of America's newsroom dated 2025-12-09, as did press coverage (Sports Business Journal, Portland Business Journal).

source.name: Portland Timbers: Portland Timbers enter multi-year partnership with Bank of America to become front-of-jersey partner
source.quote: Tillamook will transition its kit placement to the sleeve patch, continuing its commitment to the club

source.name: FOR SOCCER: 2026 MLS Jersey Sponsors
source.quote: media partner Apple, once again, will be on the left sleeve of every jersey

summary: All MLS clubs wear Adidas; Apple TV is on the left sleeve of every kit. Bank of America fronts the jersey; Tillamook moved from the front to the sleeve.
